headline: Making workforce risk visible before it impacts performance | Prevention-first across MSK & mental health | Champion Health
bio: Most organisations don’t struggle because they lack support. They struggle because they can’t see where workforce risk is building early enough. By the time it shows up in absence data, OH referrals, or performance decline, the system has already absorbed the impact. That’s the gap I focus on.I work with large employers to make workforce risk visible earlier, across both musculoskeletal (MSK) and mental health, so intervention happens before it translates into capacity loss or operational strain.
